message.content: This file implements the USB console driver for the RP2040, exposing a CDC-ACM device as `/dev/ttyACM0` and the Pico SDK reset interface so `picotool reboot -u` can trigger a BOOTSEL reset. It exports the transmit ring `usb_tx_ring`, the `struct tty` array `usbttys[1]`, and the counters `usb_e15_deferred` and `usb_e15_bulkin_arms` for the kernel to access. The driver depends on the internal RP2040 USB and flash modules (`rp2040/dev/usb`, `rp2040/dev/flash`) and the ROM reset service invoked via `rom_func_lookup(ROM_RESET_USB_BOOT)`. Notable design choices include placing the 8 KB transmit ring in the `.scratch` section to keep it out of the striped SRAM banks, using a ring buffer to preserve boot messages for late‑opening terminals, and implementing the RP2040‑E15 guard that defers bulk IN arms to the 800–998 µs window of each frame to avoid a known host‑controller race condition.
